slides.headline: ROAS is not profit
slides.body: A 3x return on ad spend sounds healthy. Here is the same ad set after the costs nobody puts in the dashboard.

slides.headline: Returns
slides.body: In apparel, 18% comes back. Every returned order still paid for the ad that sold it.

slides.headline: Shipping and the gateway
slides.body: The gateway takes about 2% and the return shipping is yours. Neither is in the ROAS number.

slides.headline: The break-even ROAS
slides.body: With a 60% gross margin and those costs, 3x loses money and 4.5x makes a little. That is the number to target.

slides.headline: Put the real number in the sheet
slides.body: Take last month's revenue. Subtract returns, shipping, gateway and ad spend. What is left is the business.

caption:
A 3x ROAS looks fine until you subtract returns, shipping and the gateway fee.

Same ad set, after the real costs:

3x: loses money
4.5x: makes a little

Most dashboards show the first number and hide the other three. Put them in one sheet and the answer is obvious.
